$comment: Vietnamese typography as macOS vi writes it: curly “…” primary (Finder “^0”, ~620 pairs in the pile), curly ‘…’ nested (AppKit ‘%@’ inside a sentence), no native apostrophe beyond ’ in a kept English name. Spacing is English-like: nothing before : ; ? ! or %. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: no space before : ; ? ! in Vietnamese (French-style spacing is wrong here); a literal ? or ! mid-sentence, like a wildcard, is fine

hedges.why: a bracketed plural marker or classifier ("(các) tệp"); vi nouns don't inflect, so write the plain noun or use ICU plural
a slashed gendered pronoun ("anh/chị"); address the user as bạn or drop the pronoun
an English bracketed plural left in the Vietnamese; vi nouns don't inflect
